result.keyword: Best payment platform for indie SaaS developers: Stripe vs Polar vs Dodo Payments vs Creem in 2026?
result.markdown:
Choosing a payment platform as an indie SaaS or AI developer in 2026 comes down to one fundamental architectural choice: **Do you want to act as the Merchant of Record (MoR) and handle global taxes yourself (Stripe), or do you want a Merchant of Record to legally shoulder global tax liability, compliance, and fraud for you (Polar, Dodo Payments, and Creem)?**

For indie developers, the traditional path of using Stripe means tracking economic nexus across 50 US states and global VAT/GST regimes, dealing with surprise account freezes, and paying extra for tax calculation tools.[www.creem.io](https://www.creem.io/comparisons/stripe#:~:text=The%20savings%20come%20from%20eliminating%20international%20card,including%20local%20payment%20methods%20for%20different%20regions.) That has driven a massive shift toward MoR platforms built explicitly for modern builders.

---

### Comparison Matrix

| Feature / Metric | Stripe (Processor) | Polar (MoR) | Dodo Payments (MoR) | Creem (MoR) |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Model | Payment Processor | Merchant of Record | Merchant of Record | Merchant of Record |
| Pricing / Fees | ~2.9% + 30¢ + hidden add-ons (Tax, FX fees, etc.) | 3.4% – 5% + flat fees depending on tier | 4% + 40¢ | 3.9% + 40¢ |
| Global Tax Filing | **You** are responsible (Stripe Tax costs extra) | Included (MoR) | Included (MoR) | Included & Remitted (MoR) |
| AI / Usage Billing | Manual tracking or Stripe Billing setup | Native usage metering & credit system | Strong native metered & hybrid models | Built-in credits & usage management |
| Best For | High-volume scale, total custom control | AI tool builders, open-source devs | Fast checkout integrations, global payout rails | Indie SaaS, co-founder splits, built-in affiliates |

---

### Deep Dive Into Each Platform

#### 1. Stripe (The Industry Standard)
* **How it works:** You are the merchant. You own the direct relationship with the financial rails, but you are also entirely liable for sales tax collection, VAT compliance, chargebacks, and sudden account reviews.
* **The Catch for Indie Devs:** While Stripe’s headline rate looks low (2.9% + 30¢), once you add international card fees (+1.5%), subscription management fees, and Stripe Tax to handle global compliance, your effective rate often creeps past **5.6%**, and **you** still have to file your own taxes in foreign countries.
* **Verdict:** Best if you have a legal team, cross-border tax entities set up, or require hyper-custom enterprise payment flows. Otherwise, it's a massive operational distraction for a solo builder.

#### 2. Polar (`polar.sh`)
* **How it works:** Positioned heavily toward developer-first products and AI tooling. Polar acts as your Merchant of Record while doubling down on native infrastructure for modern software monetization.
* **Standout Features:** Outstanding **Usage Billing Engine** built for AI apps (tracking tokens, GPU seconds, and event ingestion alongside standard SaaS subscriptions). They also offer an MCP (Model Context Protocol) server allowing you to query revenue or generate products directly from AI coding environments like Claude, Cursor, or ChatGPT.
* **Pricing Structure:** Offers flexible tiers ranging from a free/starter baseline to Pro/Growth/Scale plans that lower transaction percentages for scaling businesses. 
* **Verdict:** **The top pick for AI-native SaaS, API-first products, and developers building in public.**

#### 3. Dodo Payments
* **How it works:** A developer-centric MoR focused on rapid embedded checkouts (inline, modal, or API) and localized global payment rails.[dodopayments.com](https://dodopayments.com/blogs/embedded-payments-saas-platforms#:~:text=How%20Dodo%20Payments%20Approaches%20Embedded%20Payments.%20Dodo,billing%20state%20change%20with%20built-in%20idempotency%20support.)
* **Standout Features:** Exceptional focus on regional payment methods (e.g., UPI, Pix, BLIK) and alternative settlement options like stablecoins (USDC/USDT) alongside traditional cards. They provide robust dunning management, automated churn recovery, and embedded customer portals.[dodopayments.com](https://dodopayments.com/blogs/embedded-payments-saas-platforms#:~:text=Automatic%203DS%2C%20fraud%20screening%2C%20and%20retry%20logic.,cents%20per%20transaction%20with%20no%20monthly%20fees.)
* **Pricing Structure:** Straightforward pricing at roughly 4% + 40¢ with no monthly platform fees.[dodopayments.com](https://dodopayments.com/blogs/embedded-payments-saas-platforms#:~:text=Automatic%203DS%2C%20fraud%20screening%2C%20and%20retry%20logic.,cents%20per%20transaction%20with%20no%20monthly%20fees.)
* **Verdict:** **Great if you have a heavy international user base** that demands diverse regional payment methods and want an embedded checkout experience that can be spun up in an afternoon.

#### 4. Creem (`creem.io`)
* **How it works:** A lean, indie-first Merchant of Record built explicitly to give solo founders and small teams a frictionless alternative to Stripe without the enterprise bloat of legacy MoRs like Paddle.[www.creem.io](https://www.creem.io/blog/stripe-alternatives-top-providers-2026#:~:text=Creem%20is%20a%20Merchant%20of%20Record%20built,invoicing%2C%20compliance%2C%20fraud%20protection%2C%20and%20dispute%20handling.)
* **Standout Features:** All-inclusive tax collection and remittance across 130+ countries. Creem packs heavy indie-friendly utilities directly into the dashboard: **built-in affiliate management**, automated revenue/co-founder splits, and native software **license key generation**.[www.creem.io](https://www.creem.io/comparisons/stripe#:~:text=Tools%20built%20for%20digital%20product%20creators%20and,Perfect%20for%20global%20teams.%20*%20Customer%20portal.)
* **Pricing Structure:** Transparent flat rate of 3.9% + 40¢ with no hidden subscription surcharges or international card penalties.[www.creem.io](https://www.creem.io/comparisons/stripe#:~:text=The%20savings%20come%20from%20eliminating%20international%20card,including%20local%20payment%20methods%20for%20different%20regions.)
* **Verdict:** **The best all-around value for traditional indie SaaS apps, digital goods, and bootstrapped founders** who want affiliates and license keys handled natively out of the box.[www.creem.io](https://www.creem.io/comparisons/stripe#:~:text=Launch%20affiliate%20programs%20in%20minutes%20with%20referral,customers%2C%20and%20forecasts.%20Save%20%2410%2C000%2B%20per%20year.)

---

### Summary Recommendation: Which one should you pick?

* **Choose Polar** if you are building an **AI wrapper, LLM tool, or API-heavy platform** where usage-based metering (per-token or per-request billing) is central to your business model.
* **Choose Creem** if you are building a **classic B2B or B2C indie SaaS**, want zero hidden fees, and can benefit immensely from built-in affiliate tracking and automated co-founder revenue splits.
* **Choose Dodo Payments** if your primary bottleneck is **global conversion and localized payment rails** (such as regional wallets and alternative crypto settlements).
* **Stick with Stripe only** if you have complex multi-entity corporate structuring and an accountant ready to manually file global tax returns. For 90% of solo indie devs in 2026, the MoR route saves dozens of hours of compliance headache.
